changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AgentErrorItem') BEGIN IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_FusionAgentErrorItem_FusionAgentError' and object_name(parent_object_id) = 'AgentErrorItem' and schema_name(schema_id) = 'fusion' ) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [fusion].[AgentErrorItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_FusionAgentErrorItem_FusionAgentError] END exec sp_rename 'fusion.AgentErrorItem', 'AgentErrorItem_backup'; END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'fusion' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AgentErrorItem_backup') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'fusion.AgentErrorItem_backup', 'AgentErrorItem'; END
